Teaching Guide: Developing Ideas Logically in the ‘Discussion’ Section (1/2)

教学指南：在「讨论（Discussion）」部分有逻辑地发展论点（1/2）

Task 2 Developing ideas logically — Task 2a Course Slides, p. 10

In the ‘Discussion’ section, each paragraph centres on a main idea, which is introduced in the topic sentence, typically the first sentence of the paragraph. The supporting sentences that follow elaborate on this idea with relevant details, examples, or evidence, while the concluding sentence reinforces the main idea, tying the paragraph together. A well-crafted topic sentence, detailed supporting sentences, and a concise concluding sentence create a logical structure, enhancing the clarity, flow, and persuasiveness of your arguments.

在「讨论（Discussion）」部分，每个段落围绕一个中心思想展开，通常由段落首句的主题句（topic sentence）引入。随后的支持句（supporting sentences）透过相关细节、例子或证据加以阐述，而结论句（concluding sentence）则强化中心思想，收结全段。结构严谨的主题句、详实的支持句与简明的结论句共同构成清晰的逻辑结构，提升论述的清晰度、流畅度及说服力。

Teaching Guide: Model Discussion & Concluding an Evaluation Report (2/2)

教学指南：讨论段落示范与「总结（Conclusion）」两步结构（空格16–20）

Part A: Model Discussion Paragraph (‘CyberSecure HK’ Project) Course Slides, p. 11

A部分：讨论段落逻辑结构示范（「CyberSecure HK」项目，课程简报第11页）
The findings indicate that the four workshops have effectively enabled small business owners to be more aware of cybersecurity threats as well as the preventive measures. Due to their enhanced cybersecurity knowledge and skills, they regularly scan their online systems for potential threats, identify phishing emails, and promptly report suspicious online scams. In other words, they have strengthened their digital security.
研究结果显示，四场工作坊有效提高了小企业主对网络安全威胁及预防措施的认识。由于网络安全知识和技能得以提升，他们定期扫描网上系统以排查潜在威胁、识别钓鱼电邮，并及时举报可疑的网上诈骗。换言之，他们强化了数码安全。
Topic sentence (Blanks 16–17):Main idea – the workshops are effective in enhancing participants’ cybersecurity awareness
主题句（对应空格16–17）：中心思想 — 工作坊有效提升参加者的网络安全意识
Supporting sentence (Elaboration & Blank 18):Elaboration – giving details about how enhanced knowledge changes participants’ practices
支持句（对应阐述及空格18）：具体说明知识提升如何改变参加者的实际做法
Concluding sentence (Blank 19 & Elaboration):Reinforcement – reiterating project effectiveness in relation to the project’s aims
结论句（对应空格19及阐述）：结合项目目标重申项目的成效

Part B: Concluding an Evaluation Report (2 Key Components → Blank 20) Conclusion Slides, pp. 3–4 B部分：总结评估报告（两个核心组成部分 → 空格20）

Following the ‘Discussion’ section, the Conclusion provides a clear and concise judgement on the project’s success or areas for improvement by restating the project’s objectives and highlighting critical outcomes.

B部分：紧接「讨论」部分，「总结（Conclusion）」透过重申项目目标及重点成果，对项目的成功或可改进之处作出清晰简明的判断。

The findings indicate that the project has been largely successful in raising small business owners’ knowledge of cybersecurity.

While similar training should continue to be offered, there is some room for improvement to make the project more effective.

研究结果显示，该项目在提升小企业主网络安全知识方面大致成功。虽然应继续提供类似培训，但仍有改进空间以提升项目成效。
1. Addressing the project’s success in relation to the project’s objective (Blank 20):To conclude, the project has been successful / effective in (20) [Verb + -ing].
第1句（蓝色，对应空格20）：针对项目目标说明项目的成效（address = 针对／处理）。
2. Recommending continued action while highlighting the potential for improvement:While similar projects should continue to be offered, there are some areas that could be improved for better results.
第2句（绿色，模板固定句）：建议继续推行类似项目，同时指出仍有改进空间。

Evaluation report on the ‘Mobile Game Development Basics’ project

「Mobile Game Development Basics」手机游戏开发基础项目评估报告

1. Introduction 引言

The booming mobile gaming industry has sparked teenagers’ interest in game development. Despite this growing enthusiasm, many lack the technical knowledge and creative skills needed to design functional and engaging games.Situation 背景 The objective of the ‘Mobile Game Development Basics’ project is to teach teenagers foundational skills in game design, programming, and problem-solving through hands-on workshops.Objective 项目目标 This report assesses the effectiveness of the project and provides suggestions for future improvement.

蓬勃发展的手机游戏产业激发了青少年对游戏开发的兴趣。尽管热情日益高涨，但许多人缺乏设计实用且吸引人的游戏所需的技术知识和创意技能。「Mobile Game Development Basics」项目的目标是透过实践工作坊，教授青少年游戏设计、编程和解难的基础技能。本报告评估该项目的成效，并就未来改进提供建议。

2. Methodology 方法

2.1 Participants 参与者

Three professional game developers were recruited as trainers, while 40 teenagers from various secondary schools in Hong Kong were invited to participate in the project.

招募了三名专业游戏开发人员担任导师，并邀请了来自香港多所中学的40名青少年参与该项目。

2.2 Implementation 实施

From January to February 202-, five workshops were conducted by the trainers. These sessions covered topics such as coding basics using the Unity game engine, designing user interfaces, implementing game mechanics, and testing functionality. Participants engaged in practical exercises, including prototyping simple games and troubleshooting common issues.What they did → learned 做了什么 → 学了什么

202-年1月至2月，导师举办了五场工作坊。课程内容涵盖使用 Unity 游戏引擎的基础编程、设计用户界面、实现游戏机制及测试功能。参加者参与了实践练习，包括制作简单游戏原型及排查常见问题。

2.3 Evaluation 评估

To evaluate the project, participants had been invited to complete a pre-project survey in December 202- assessing their prior knowledge of game development. In March 202-, a post-project survey was administered, and online group discussions were held to gather feedback on their experiences and challenges faced during the workshops.

为评估该项目，参加者于202-年12月完成了项目前调查，评估其游戏开发的原有知识。202-年3月进行了项目后调查，并举行网上小组讨论以收集他们在工作坊中的体验与面对的挑战。
Source LAN4103_IT_Revision Package II (Teacher Version), pp. 2–3: completed Sections 1–2 with teacher highlights. Template Reuse these highlighted clues in Discussion (blanks 16–19), Conclusion (blank 20), and Recommendations (blank 21 target audience).

Logical Paragraph Breakdown (Applying Course Slides pp. 10–12 to Task 1 Discussion) 讨论段落三步逻辑拆解

The findings indicate that the five workshops have effectively enabled the teenagers to acquire foundational skills in game development and apply them practically. With the knowledge gained, participants demonstrated improved confidence in coding, designing user interfaces, and testing game functionality. Overall, the project has successfully enhanced their technical skills and creativity, inspiring many to explore careers in game development further.

Task 1 — Rewritten Possible Response (Using EAII Template)

任务一 — 按 EAII 模板改写的完整参考回应（附全部数据来源标签及原版教师答案对照）

Below is the complete Task 1 evaluation report (Sections 3–6) rewritten strictly using LAN4103 EAII Template.docx, with every blank (1)–(23) and data source inline-labelled.

以下为严格按照「LAN4103 EAII 模板.docx」改写的任务一完整评估报告（第3–6部分），内文逐一标示空格（1）–（23）及数据来源。

3. Findings 研究结果（空格1–15）

After the project, (1) around two-thirds (65%) Q1 Capable Post of the respondents said that they (2) were capable of applying basic coding and game design principles Q1 Stem, which was a significant increase from (3) only 10% Q1 Capable Pre before the project. (4) One-quarter (25%) Q1 Somewhat capable Post of them reported that they (5) were somewhat capable of applying these principles Q1 Stem, compared to (6) 5% Q1 Somewhat capable Pre before. Moreover, the number of respondents who (7) were motivated to pursue further studies in game development Q2 Stem + Motivated rose sharply from (8) 15% Q2 Motivated Pre to (9) 55% Q2 Motivated Post, while those (10) who were not motivated to do so Q2 Not motivated fell drastically from (11) 80% Q2 Not motivated Pre to (12) 12% Q2 Not motivated Post.

项目结束后，(1) 约三分之二（65%）的受访者表示他们 (2) 有能力应用基础编程及游戏设计原则，较项目前的 (3) 仅10%显著增加。(4) 四分之一（25%）的受访者表示自己 (5) 颇有能力应用这些原则，而项目前仅为 (6) 5%。此外，(7) 有动力继续进修游戏开发的受访者比例由 (8) 15%急升至 (9) 55%，而 (10) 没有动力进修的比例则由 (11) 80%大幅下降至 (12) 12%。

It was also found that (13) the hands-on prototyping exercises were useful and interesting Feedback 1. However, some respondents mentioned that (14) the workshop materials were rather basic, particularly for advanced participants Feedback 2. Furthermore, some of them suggested that (15) manual debugging required a significant amount of time and there was not enough time during the hands-on sessions Feedback 3.

调查亦发现，(13) 制作简单游戏原型的实践练习既实用又有趣。然而，部分受访者提到 (14) 工作坊教材较为基础，特别是对进阶参加者而言。此外，部分受访者反映 (15) 手动除错耗费大量时间，导致实践环节的时间不足。

4. Discussion 讨论（空格16–19 · 主题句 → 支持句 → 结论句）

The findings suggest that the (16) five workshops Notes: Discussion pt 1 have effectively (17) enabled the teenagers to acquire foundational skills in game development and apply them practically Topic sentence (Notes pt 1). With the knowledge gained in the Unity game engine, participants demonstrated improved confidence in coding, designing user interfaces, and testing game functionality Supporting sentence (Methodology 2.2). Moreover, participants have benefited from (18) the hands-on prototyping and troubleshooting exercises Supporting sentence (2.2), which (19) successfully enhanced their technical skills and creativity Notes: Discussion pt 2. This has inspired many of them to explore further studies and careers in game development Concluding sentence (Notes pt 2).

研究结果显示，(16) 五场工作坊已有效 (17) 让青少年掌握游戏开发的基础技能并加以实践应用。凭藉在 Unity 游戏引擎中学到的知识，参加者在编程、设计用户界面及测试游戏功能方面展现出更强的信心。此外，参加者从 (18) 原型制作及除错实践练习中获益良多，从而 (19) 成功提升了他们的技术技能和创意。这亦启发了不少参加者进一步探索游戏开发的进修及职业发展。

5. Conclusion 总结（空格20）

To conclude, the project has been effective in (20) enhancing teenagers’ technical skills and creativity while fostering an interest in game development Notes: Conclusion. While similar projects should continue to be offered, there are some areas that could be improved for better results Template sentence 2.

总结而言，该项目在 (20) 提升青少年的技术技能和创意，以及培养他们对游戏开发的兴趣方面成效显著。虽然应继续举办类似项目，但仍有部分范畴可以改进，以取得更好成果。

6. Recommendations 建议（空格21–23）

In light of the positive outcomes, it is recommended that (21) regular workshops Notes: Rec pt 1 could be offered to secondary school students Target audience (2.1) so that more students can benefit, while previous participants will have opportunities to refine their skills and work on more advanced projects Benefit elaboration. Moreover, it is advisable that (22) tiered activities Notes: Rec pt 2 + Feedback 2 should be developed to address the various levels of learners in our project and engage both beginners and advanced participants Benefit elaboration. In addition, we should (23) equip participants with debugging tools or automated error-checking software Notes: Rec pt 3 + Feedback 3 in order to significantly reduce the time and effort required for troubleshooting, streamlining the learning process and enhancing efficiency Benefit elaboration.

鉴于正面成果，建议向中学生提供 (21) 定期工作坊，让更多学生受益，同时让之前的参加者有机会精进技能并参与更进阶的项目。此外，建议设计并安排 (22) 分层教学活动，以照顾项目中不同程度的学习者，让初学者及进阶参加者均能投入其中。再者，我们应 (23) 为参加者提供除错工具或自动错误检查软件，以大幅减少排查问题所需的时间和精力，简化学习流程并提升效率。
View Original Teacher Version Possible Response (IT RPII PDF, pp. 3–5) 查看教师版原始参考答案（PDF 第3–5页）

3. Findings (Teacher Version, pp. 3–4) 研究结果（教师版原文）

Around two-thirds of the participants reported feeling capable of applying basic coding and game design principles after the project, compared to only 10% before it began. One-quarter of them described themselves as somewhat capable, which showed a notable improvement from 5% prior to the project. Moreover, the number of respondents who expressed motivation to pursue further studies in game development grew substantially from 15% to 55%, while the number of respondents who did not express any motivation dropped remarkably from 80% to 12% after the project.

项目结束后，约三分之二的参加者表示有能力应用基础编程及游戏设计原则，而项目开始前仅为10%。四分之一的参加者形容自己颇有能力，较项目前的5%有明显进步。此外，表示有动力继续进修游戏开发的受访者比例由15%大幅增加至55%，而没有表达任何进修动力的受访者比例则由项目前的80%显著下降至项目后的12%。

Participants praised the hands-on prototyping exercises as useful and interesting. However, some commented that the workshop materials were too basic, particularly for advanced participants. Furthermore, a few participants noted that manual debugging required a significant amount of time and that there was also not enough time during the hands-on sessions.

参加者称赞制作原型的实践练习既实用又有趣。然而，部分人反映工作坊教材过于基础，特别是对进阶参加者而言。此外，少数参加者指出手动除错耗费大量时间，而且实践环节的时间亦不足够。

4. Discussion (Teacher Version, p. 4) 讨论（教师版原文）

The findings indicate that the five workshops have effectively enabled the teenagers to acquire foundational skills in game development and apply them practically. With the knowledge gained, participants demonstrated improved confidence in coding, designing user interfaces, and testing game functionality. Overall, the project has successfully enhanced their technical skills and creativity, inspiring many to explore careers in game development further.

研究结果显示，五场工作坊已有效让青少年掌握游戏开发的基础技能并加以实践应用。凭藉所学知识，参加者在编程、设计用户界面及测试游戏功能方面展现出更强的信心。整体而言，该项目成功提升了他们的技术技能与创意，启发许多人进一步探索游戏开发的职业发展。

5. Conclusion (Teacher Version, p. 5) 总结（教师版原文）

The findings suggest that the project has been mostly effective in enhancing teenagers’ technical skills and creativity while fostering an interest in game development. Although similar workshops should continue to be offered, there is room for refinement to ensure the project’s long-term success and broader impact.

研究结果显示，该项目在提升青少年的技术技能和创意，以及培养他们对游戏开发的兴趣方面大致成效显著。虽然应继续举办类似工作坊，但仍有完善空间，以确保项目的长远成功及更广泛的影响力。

6. Recommendations (Teacher Version, p. 5) 建议（教师版原文）

Considering the positive findings, it is recommended that similar workshops be offered on a regular basis so that more students can benefit, while previous participants will have opportunities to refine their skills and work on more advanced projects.

To address the various levels of learners in our project, it is advisable to incorporate tiered activities to engage both beginners and advanced participants. Additionally, equipping participants with debugging tools or automated error-checking software could significantly reduce the time and effort required for troubleshooting, streamlining the learning process and enhancing efficiency.

考虑到正面的研究结果，建议定期举办类似工作坊，让更多学生受益，同时让之前的参加者有机会精进技能并参与更进阶的项目。为照顾项目中不同程度的学习者，建议加入分层教学活动，让初学者及进阶参加者均能投入其中。此外，为参加者配备除错工具或自动错误检查软件，可大幅减少排查问题所需的时间和精力，从而简化学习流程并提升效率。

Task 2: ‘Advanced Content Creation’ Project — Situation & Brief

任务二：「Advanced Content Creation」进阶数码内容创作项目 — 任务情境与要求

Task 2 situation: You are Will Kwok, a student intern at Tech Solutions Limited. You have conducted a mini-project to teach teenagers advanced video-taking and editing skills to produce high-quality digital content.

任务情境：你是 Tech Solutions Limited 的实习生 Will Kwok。你举办了一项小型项目，教授青少年进阶影片拍摄及剪辑技巧，以制作高质素的数码内容。

You are required to write an evaluation report to the manager discussing the effectiveness of the project and giving recommendations for the way forward. The first half of the report has been completed. Evaluation report on the ‘Advanced Content Creation’ project

「Advanced Content Creation」进阶内容创作项目评估报告

1. Introduction 引言

The aspiration to become influencers has surged among teenagers, yet many lack the skills required to produce high-quality digital content.Situation 背景 The ‘Content Creation’ project aims to equip teenagers with the necessary skills to produce professional-quality content by teaching them advanced video-taking and editing skills, livestreaming techniques, and to motivate them to become professional content creators.Objectives 项目目标 This report discusses the effectiveness of the project, evaluates its impact on participants, and provides recommendations for future improvements.

青少年成为网红（influencers）的愿望日益强烈，但许多人缺乏制作高质素数码内容所需的技能。「Content Creation」项目旨在透过教授进阶影片拍摄与剪辑技巧、直播技术，装备青少年制作专业质素内容的必要技能，并激励他们成为专业内容创作者。本报告讨论项目成效、评估其对参加者的影响，并提出未来改进建议。

2. Methodology 方法

2.1 Participants 参与者

Three professional content creators were recruited as trainers, while 40 teenagers from various secondary schools in Hong Kong were invited to participate in the project.

招募了三名专业内容创作者担任导师，并邀请了来自香港多所中学的40名青少年参与该项目。

2.2 Implementation 实施

From January to February 202-, four workshops were delivered by the trainers. These workshops covered filming techniques, video-taking and livestreaming skills, and editing software in detail. Participants were given hands-on practice with real-world scenarios, allowing them to apply what they learned effectively.What they did → learned 做了什么 → 学了什么

202-年1月至2月，导师举办了四场工作坊，详细涵盖拍摄技巧、录影与直播技能及剪辑软件。参加者透过真实情境进行实践练习，有效应用所学知识。

2.3 Evaluation 评估

To evaluate the project, participants have been requested to take part in a pre-project survey in December 202- about their content creation skills. In March 202-, a post-project survey was conducted, and online focus group interviews were organised for participants to share their experiences.

为评估该项目，参加者于202-年12月参与了有关其内容创作技能的项目前调查。202-年3月进行了项目后调查，并举办网上焦点小组访谈让参加者分享体验。

3. Findings 研究结果（空格1–15）

After the project, (1) three-fourths (75%) Q1 Very good Post of the respondents said that they (2) were very good at applying filming and editing skills to make videos Q1 Stem, which was a significant increase from (3) only 10% Q1 Very good Pre before the project. (4) One-fifth (20%) Q1 Good Post of them reported that they (5) were good at applying these skills Q1 Stem, compared to (6) 5% Q1 Good Pre before. Moreover, the number of respondents who (7) felt highly confident in creating content professionally Q2 Stem + Highly confident rose sharply from (8) 20% Q2 Highly confident Pre to (9) 70% Q2 Highly confident Post, while those (10) who felt somewhat confident Q2 Somewhat confident fell drastically from (11) 60% Q2 Somewhat confident Pre to (12) 10% Q2 Somewhat confident Post.

项目结束后，(1) 四分之三（75%）的受访者表示自己在 (2) 运用拍摄及剪辑技巧制作影片方面表现非常好，较项目前的 (3) 仅10%显著增加。(4) 五分之一（20%）的受访者表示自己 (5) 在运用这些技巧方面表现良好，而项目前仅为 (6) 5%。此外，(7) 对专业创作内容感到非常有信心的受访者比例由 (8) 20%急升至 (9) 70%，而 (10) 感到颇有信心的比例则由 (11) 60%大幅下降至 (12) 10%。

It was also found that (13) the tips about visual design and composition in video creation were quite beneficial Feedback 1. However, some respondents mentioned that (14) they wished for more personalised feedback on their work to better understand their strengths and areas for improvement Feedback 2. Furthermore, some of them suggested that (15) additional resources should be provided to facilitate their video editing process and review the quality of their work Feedback 3.

调查亦发现，(13) 有关影片创作中视觉设计及构图的贴士非常实用。然而，部分受访者提到 (14) 他们希望作品能获得更多个人化回馈，以更了解自己的优点及可改进之处。此外，部分受访者建议 (15) 提供更多剪辑资源，以协助其影片剪辑流程并检视作品质素。

The hands-on workshops provided practical experience, enabling participants to apply filming and editing techniques to create digital content Supporting sentence (Methodology 2.2). Moreover, participants have benefited from (18) this practical approach with real-world scenarios Supporting sentence (Notes pt 2 + 2.2), which (19) significantly strengthened their technical skills and confidence Notes: Discussion pt 2. This has motivated them to become professional content creators in the future Concluding sentence (Intro Aim).

研究结果显示，(16) 四场工作坊已有效 (17) 装备青少年内容创作的技能。实践工作坊提供了宝贵的实作经验，让参加者能运用拍摄及剪辑技巧创作数码内容。此外，参加者从 (18) 结合真实情境的实践教学方式中获益，从而 (19) 显著强化了他们的技术技能和信心，激励他们在未来成为专业内容创作者。

View Original Teacher Version Possible Response (IT RPII PDF, pp. 10–11) 查看教师版原始参考答案（PDF 第10–11页）

3. Findings (Teacher Version, p. 10) 研究结果（教师版原文）

Three-fourths of the respondents rated themselves as very good at applying filming and editing skills to make videos, compared to only 10% before the project. One-fifth of them rated themselves as good, which showed a notable increase from the mere 5% before. Moreover, the number of respondents who felt highly confident to create content professionally increased sharply from 20% to 70%, while the number of respondents who felt somewhat confident fell drastically from 60% to 10%.

四分之三的受访者认为自己在运用拍摄及剪辑技巧制作影片方面表现非常好，而项目前仅为10%。五分之一的受访者认为自己表现良好，较项目前仅5%有明显上升。此外，对专业创作内容感到非常有信心的受访者人数由20%急升至70%，而感到颇有信心的人数则由60%大幅下降至10%。

It was also mentioned that the tips about visual design and composition in video creation were quite beneficial. However, some participants expressed a desire for more personalised feedback on their work to better understand their strengths and areas for improvement. In addition, they looked forward to additional resources to facilitate their video editing process and review the quality of their work.

受访者亦提到，有关影片创作中视觉设计及构图的贴士非常实用。然而，部分参加者表示希望作品能获得更多个人化回馈，以更了解自己的强项及需改进之处。此外，他们期望获得更多资源，以协助影片剪辑流程并检视作品质素。

4. Discussion (Teacher Version, p. 10) 讨论（教师版原文）

The findings suggest that the four workshops have effectively equipped teenagers with content creation skills. The hands-on workshops provided practical experience, enabling participants to apply filming and editing techniques to create digital content. This practical approach has significantly strengthened their technical skills and confidence to become professional content creators in the future.

研究结果显示，四场工作坊已有效装备青少年内容创作的技能。实践工作坊提供了实作经验，让参加者能运用拍摄及剪辑技巧创作数码内容。这种实践教学方式显著强化了他们的技术技能与信心，使他们未来能成为专业内容创作者。

5. Conclusion (Teacher Version, p. 10) 总结（教师版原文）

The project has been successful in improving the teenagers’ content creation knowledge and skills, and in enhancing their confidence to become professional content creators. While similar workshops should continue to be offered, there is some room for enhancement to make the project even more impactful.

该项目成功提升了青少年的内容创作知识与技能，并增强了他们成为专业内容创作者的信心。虽然应继续举办类似工作坊，但仍有改进空间，使项目发挥更大影响力。

6. Recommendations (Teacher Version, p. 11) 建议（教师版原文）

Given the positive outcomes, it is recommended that the project be expanded to include additional topics, which would further develop teenagers’ skills while providing them with opportunities to explore diverse content formats, such as podcasts and social media campaigns.

Moreover, it is recommended that a feedback session be added so the trainers can give individual feedback to the participants’ work. To further support the participants, access to advanced resources such as premium editing software and exclusive content libraries could be provided.

鉴于正面成果，建议扩展项目以涵盖更多主题，进一步发展青少年的技能，同时为他们提供探索播客及社交媒体企划等多元内容形式的机会。此外，建议增设回馈环节，让导师能就参加者的作品提供个人化意见。为进一步支援参加者，可提供专业剪辑软件及专属素材库等进阶资源。

3. Findings

Regarding the question ① ‘How good are you at applying filming and editing skills to make videos?’, 75% of the participants reported ‘very good’ post-project, while 10% said so pre-project. ② Also, 20% answered ‘good’ post-project, compared to 5% pre-project.

Concerning the question ③ ‘How confident are you in creating content professionally?’, 70% of the participants reported ‘highly confident’ post-project, whereas 10% said ‘somewhat confident’. ④ At the same time, 20% answered ‘highly confident’ pre-project, while 60% said ‘somewhat confident’.

⑤ It was commented that (1) the tips about visual design and composition in video creation were quite beneficial. ⑥ However, some participants pointed out that (2) they wished for more personalised feedback on their work to better understand their strengths and areas for improvement. ⑦ Moreover, some of them complained that (3) additional resources should be provided to facilitate their video editing process and review the quality of their work.

3. 研究结果。就问题1「你在运用拍摄及剪辑技巧制作影片方面表现如何？」，项目后 75% 的受访者表示「非常好」，而项目前为 10%；另有 20% 在项目后回答「好」，相比之下项目前为 5%。就问题2「你在专业创作内容方面有多大信心？」，项目后 70% 表示「非常有信心」，10% 表示「颇有信心」；与此同时，项目前 20% 表示「非常有信心」，60% 表示「颇有信心」。调查发现 (1) 有关影片创作中视觉设计及构图的贴士非常实用。然而，部分受访者指出 (2) 他们希望作品能获得更多个人化回馈，以更了解自己的优点及可改进之处。此外，部分受访者抱怨 (3) 应提供更多剪辑资源，以协助影片剪辑流程并检视作品质素。

4. Discussion

①②⑨The findings suggest that the four workshops have effectively ⑧equipped teenagers with content creation skills. They gained knowledge from the hands-on workshops and demonstrated improved confidence in applying filming and editing techniques to create digital content. Moreover, participants have benefited from this practical approach with real-world scenarios, which significantly ⑧strengthened their technical skills and confidence. ③④This has ⑧motivated them to become professional content creators in the future.

4. 讨论。研究结果显示，四场工作坊已有效装备青少年内容创作的技能。实践工作坊提供了宝贵的实作经验，让参加者能运用拍摄及剪辑技巧创作数码内容。此外，参加者从结合真实情境的实践教学方式中获益，从而显著强化了他们的技术技能和信心，激励他们在未来成为专业内容创作者。

While similar projects / schemes should continue to be implemented, there is some room for improvement to make the project more effective.

6. Recommendations

⑤ In view of the positive findings, it is recommended that (5)workshops covering additional topics could be offered to teenagers # so that they can further develop their skills and explore diverse content formats, such as podcasts and social media campaigns.

⑥ Meanwhile, it is advisable that (6)a feedback session should be arranged # to allow the trainers to give individual feedback on the participants’ work.

⑦ To further improve the project, it is suggested that (7)access to advanced resources such as premium editing software and exclusive content libraries be provided # in order to further support the participants in their video editing process and help them produce high-quality work.
